svg.text: 32-bit RISC-V (RV32IM) · 6-stage pipeline (IF / ID / EX / MEM / LA / WB) · forwarding · multi-cycle MUL/DIV · 64 KB clocked RAM
stall = MUL/DIV busy · loadstall = load → use
holds PC + ID, bubbles into EX (load-use: ≤ 2)
a = rs1 | PC · b = rs2 | imm
EQ NE LT GE LTU GEU
load: clocked read → data in LA
write-back to register file (+ ID forward)
LA → EX forward (ladata, only if not a load)
taken branch / JAL / JALR → PC ← target, flush (2-cycle penalty)
Tang Nano 20K (GW2AR-18, Gowin): Fmax ≈ 63 MHz · ~3,100 logic cells (15%) · RAM in 32 of 46 block RAMs · RAM ports A and B are the same 64 KB memory
